id.input: Foto produk opsional. Tanpa foto, prompt menggunakan cangkir keramik biru kobalt matte dengan badan silinder dan gagang berbentuk D, tanpa merek.
steps: Siapkan foto produk jika ingin memakai produkmu sendiri.
Salin prompt lengkap; sesuaikan warna, produk, dan rasio bila perlu.
Kirim ke ChatGPT untuk membuat gambar. Tambahkan teks promosi sendiri setelah memeriksa hasil.
id.prompt: Buat foto iklan produk persegi. Jika ada foto terlampir, gunakan produknya sebagai acuan dan pertahankan identitas visualnya. Jika tidak ada foto, gunakan cangkir keramik biru kobalt matte, berbadan silinder dengan gagang berbentuk D, tanpa logo atau tulisan. Letakkan produk sedikit di bawah tengah pada permukaan krem hangat. Tambahkan elemen kertas lengkung biru yang sederhana di latar. Gunakan cahaya lembut dari kiri atas dan bayangan kontak yang realistis. Kopi boleh terlihat di dalam cangkir. Sisakan seperempat area atas untuk judul yang akan ditambahkan kemudian. Jangan buat teks, watermark, bingkai, atau kolase.
id.result: Cangkir biru menjadi fokus di bagian bawah, dengan latar krem dan lengkung biru. Ruang kosong di atas dapat dipakai untuk menambahkan judul. Contoh ini menunjukkan arah komposisi iklan; tidak menyertakan klaim produk atau hasil kampanye.

en.summary: Product ad imagery with room in the composition for a headline or offer.
en.input: A product photo is optional. Without one, the prompt uses an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle.
steps: Prepare a product photo if you want to use your own product.
Copy the full prompt and adjust the colors, product, and ratio as needed.
Ask ChatGPT to create the image. Add promotional text yourself after inspecting the result.
en.prompt: Create a square product advertisement photograph. If a photo is attached, use its product as the reference and preserve its visual identity. Otherwise, use a matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle, without logos or lettering. Place the product slightly below center on a warm cream surface. Add a simple muted-blue curved paper element in the background. Use soft light from the upper left and a realistic contact shadow. Coffee may be visible inside the mug. Leave the upper quarter empty for a headline to be added later. Do not add text, watermarks, borders, or a collage.
en.result: The blue mug is the focal point in the lower part, against a cream background and blue curve. Empty space above allows a headline to be added. This illustrates an ad composition, without product claims or campaign-performance claims.

id.prompt: Buat gambar persegi berupa konsep iklan billboard anamorfik 3D di sudut gedung kota modern saat senja. Gunakan produk dari foto terlampir bila ada; tanpa lampiran, gunakan cangkir keramik biru kobalt matte dengan badan silinder dan gagang D, tanpa merek. Layar besar yang melengkung mengikuti sudut gedung menampilkan cangkir raksasa dengan gagang seolah menonjol ke arah jalan. Tambahkan refleksi pada jalan basah dan beberapa pejalan kaki kecil sebagai pembanding skala. Gunakan warna biru dan cahaya amber dengan perspektif arsitektur yang masuk akal. Jangan tambahkan tulisan, logo baru, watermark, atau bingkai. Hasilnya adalah konsep visual fiktif, bukan dokumentasi pemasangan nyata.
id.result: Cangkir biru tampak menonjol dari layar besar di sudut gedung. Pejalan kaki dan refleksi jalan memberi kesan skala. Ini konsep ilusi perspektif; detail fisik atau kelayakan pemasangan perlu dinilai terpisah.

en.summary: A giant product concept that appears to project out of a three-dimensional billboard display.
en.input: A product photo is optional. The catalog example uses a fictional blue mug description and city building, not a real location or campaign.
steps: Attach a product photo if available.
Copy the full prompt and change the city atmosphere if needed.
Create the image and inspect the screen perspective, product scale, and shape.
en.prompt: Create a square image of a fictional 3D anamorphic billboard ad on the corner of a modern city building at dusk. Use the product in an attached photo if present; otherwise use an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle. A large curved display follows the building corner and shows a giant mug whose handle appears to project toward the street. Add reflections on wet pavement and a few tiny pedestrians to establish scale. Use blue and amber lighting with plausible architectural perspective. Do not add lettering, new logos, watermarks, or borders. This is a fictional visual concept, not documentation of a real installation.
en.result: The blue mug appears to project from a large corner display. Pedestrians and wet-street reflections establish scale. This is a perspective-illusion concept; physical details and installation feasibility need separate assessment.

en.prompt: Create a square studio product photograph. If a product photo is attached, use its shape and colors as the reference. Otherwise use an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle. Center the product on a very light grey seamless background and surface. Use a three-quarter angle at mug height, show the entire body and handle, and fill about two-thirds of the frame. Use broad softbox lighting to reveal natural ceramic texture and a soft contact shadow. No extra props, text, watermarks, floating effects, or dramatic splashes.
en.result: The complete mug and handle show clear ceramic texture. A light grey background and soft shadow keep attention on the product's shape. Compare AI output against the real product before using it in a sales catalog.

en.prompt: Create a square natural smartphone-style photo. Show a fictional adult woman about 30 wearing a cream linen shirt, seated in a kitchen at breakfast. She holds a mug at chest height in anatomically plausible hands. Use the product from an attached photo if available; otherwise use an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle. Keep the face and product clearly visible. Avoid beauty-filter effects, exaggerated advertising poses, testimonial text, benefit claims, added logos, and watermarks.
en.result: A fictional person holds the mug in a kitchen breakfast scene with natural light. Framing and texture resemble a smartphone photo. Do not present it as documentation or a testimonial from a real customer.

Copy the prompt and adjust the figures and miniature atmosphere.
Create the image and inspect object scale and tiny details.
en.prompt: Create a square macro photograph of a handcrafted diorama. If a product photo is attached, use its shape as inspiration for a tiny kiosk; otherwise create a coffee kiosk shaped like a cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and a clearly visible D-shaped handle on the right. Add a wooden service counter, three tiny figures, paper plants, and miniature coffee bags. Put the complete diorama on a rectangular wooden base on a neutral table. Show painted-wood and craft-paper textures, small warm lights, and a slightly elevated three-quarter camera angle. Use shallow macro tilt-shift focus while keeping the central scene detailed. No readable text, logos, watermarks, or borders.
en.result: A mug-shaped blue coffee stand contains a service counter, tiny figures, and warm lights. Textures and shallow focus suggest a small handmade model. This is a creative interpretation, not a technical replica that preserves every original detail.

en.summary: Turn a scene idea into a warm children's picture-book illustration.
en.input: A scene description; a reference photo is optional. Without a reference, the example uses a fictional rabbit tending a seedling in an unbranded blue mug.
steps: Choose the character, action, and setting; attach a reference photo if available.
Copy the full prompt and adapt the scene and intended reader age.
Create the image and inspect scene readability, object shapes, and character consistency before continuing to another page.
en.prompt: Create one square children's picture-book illustration. If a reference photo is attached, use its main object as inspiration for the scene; otherwise show a friendly small brown rabbit wearing an ochre apron, watering a green seedling growing in soil inside an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle. Use a small cream watering can. Keep the entire mug and handle visible. Set the scene in a simple garden with a few flowers and a wooden fence behind. Use watercolor and gouache texture on ivory paper, rounded shapes, a gentle expression, and warm morning light. Make the character's action easy to understand with an uncluttered composition. Do not add text, logos, watermarks, borders, or a collage.
en.result: An illustration of a rabbit watering a seedling in a blue mug, surrounded by flowers and a garden fence. Warm colors and painted texture support the storytelling mood. This example is one scene; character continuity across pages still needs review.
